propositions: Tickets with a live supersedes or duplicates link cannot be closed via --class=superseded or --class=duplicate without --force, because close_plan_review_gate_check does not receive the close disposition and unconditionally demands plan-review attestation

A superseded ticket's plan-review attestation is mathematically unsatisfiable — the reviewer must block on findings like 'this work already exists elsewhere', making the gate refuse the only evidence that would justify the close

The completion-verification gate (close_precheck) correctly exempts administrative dispositions with live replacement links, but the plan-review close gate was never given visibility to the disposition or the link, creating an asymmetry where one gate honors the evidence and its sibling is blind to it

The gate omission was introduced when administrative dispositions (superseded, obsolete, wontfix) were extended from bug to task/story/epic in commit fc20-2df1-426e-42ab, which modified close_precheck.py and transition_close.py but not gates.py

Forcing a superseded close strips the completion signature from the ticket and its entire ancestor epic chain, because force-close records no attestation and subsequent re-close attempts remain blocked by the same gate

The fix must thread close_class and tracker through to close_plan_review_gate_check, exempt only link-backed dispositions (superseded, duplicate) when _has_live_replacement_link returns true, and emit a distinct verdict to preserve audit-trail distinguishability from type exemptions and --force bypasses
